title: Returning-Member Credit on a Tailwise Plus Annual First Term (Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus)
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus — returning-member credit.** A returning-member credit is taken off the first-term Plus Annual fee when a customer on a free tier buys Tailwise Plus Annual. It is drawn from the membership fees already charged on the rewards ledger, by one of three methods set by the calendar days from the latest membership fee charged on the ledger to the purchase date:

1. **at most 182 days** — the credit is the sum of every membership fee charged in the last six months;
2. **more than 182 but at most 365 days** — the credit is that latest membership fee alone;
3. **more than 365 days, or no membership fee ever charged** — there is no returning-member credit.

### Both sides of each line (hypothetical)

| Days from the latest fee to the purchase | Method |
|---|---|
| 182 | sum of the fees of the last six months |
| 183 | latest fee alone |
| 365 | latest fee alone |
| 366 | no credit |

### Worked credits (hypothetical ledgers)

- Four Tailwise Plus Monthly fees of $5.99 charged in the last six months, the latest 40 days before the purchase: credit $23.96.
- One Tailwise Plus Annual fee of $59.00 charged 250 days before the purchase: credit $59.00.
- Latest fee charged 400 days before the purchase: no credit.
